extensionDescription.message: Прокачайте свой YouTube Music красивым, синхронизированным текстом песен, поддержкой разных языков, переводом в реальном времени и многим другим

options_unisonModal_controlOffset.description: Toggle label for showing the sync offset control in the dock

lyricsDock_chooseSource.description: Accessible label for the lyrics dock button that opens the source provider dropdown

lyricsDock_refresh.description: Accessible label for the lyrics dock button that re-fetches lyrics for the current song, bypassing the cache

lyricsDock_previousSource.description: Accessible label for the lyrics dock button that switches to the previous lyrics provider

lyricsDock_nextSource.description: Accessible label for the lyrics dock button that switches to the next lyrics provider

lyricsDock_offsetEarlier.description: Accessible label for the lyrics dock button that nudges sync timing earlier

lyricsDock_offsetLater.description: Accessible label for the lyrics dock button that nudges sync timing later

lyricsDock_offsetGlobal.description: Label in the lyrics dock offset menu for the global offset applied to all songs and sync types

options_offsetModal_perSongCount.description: Label in the offset settings modal showing how many per-song sync offsets are stored

options_language_displayLanguage.description: Label for the UI language selector dropdown

options_language_displayLanguageAuto.description: Option label for automatic language detection based on browser settings

lyrics_searching.description: Loading message while searching for lyrics

lyrics_noSyncedLyrics.message: Better Lyrics не удалось найти синхронизированный текст
lyrics_noSyncedLyrics.description: Message when no synced lyrics found

lyrics_notFound.description: Message when no lyrics are available

options_translation_hint.message: Нажмите, чтобы переключить. Исключенные исходные языки не будут переведены.

unison_syncRichsync.description: Sync type: word/syllable-level timing. Reused by the sync badge on cards and the sync filter chip

unison_syncLinesync.description: Sync type: line-level timing. Reused by the sync badge on cards and the sync filter chip
